name: Bamboo Charcoal Toothpaste
tagline: Activated charcoal whitening — without the grit.
shortDescription: Polishes away surface stains from coffee, tea, and wine with low-abrasion bamboo charcoal.
description: A naturally derived whitening paste that lifts daily stains from coffee, tea, and wine using finely milled bamboo charcoal. Formulated below the abrasion threshold dentists recommend — so you brighten enamel, you don't wear it down. Mint-forward, low-foam, and freshens for hours.
howToUse: Apply a pea-sized amount to a soft-bristled brush.
Brush gently in small circles for two minutes, twice daily.
Spit, don't rinse — leave the fluoride to work.
Use morning and night for visibly brighter teeth in 2–4 weeks.
highlights: Low-abrasion (under RDA 70) — safe for daily use
